This script will run a RUM model on our data assuming a stay at home option and compare it to our result of the MDCEV.

Library

Need to run the same data for the MDCEV which gives us final_data_2018. So going to clip the code from the file R script high cost.

The first code will produce final_data_yyyy by year and then should be able to run all the rest of the data

# Load datasets
reservation_data <- read_dta("data/reservation_data_merged_id_complete.dta")
intra_island_distance <- read.csv("data/intra_island_distance2.csv")

# Add year
reservation_data$year <- as.numeric(format(as.Date(reservation_data$CheckinDate, "%Y-%m-%d"), "%Y"))

reservation_data <- reservation_data %>%
  mutate(zip = ifelse(zip == 96812, 96813, zip))

# Group and compute yearly averages
avg_days_per_year <- reservation_data %>%
  group_by(year, id) %>%
  summarize(avg_days_visited = mean(days_visited, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

avg_days_2018 <- avg_days_per_year %>% filter(year == 2018)
avg_days_2019 <- avg_days_per_year %>% filter(year == 2019)
avg_days_2020 <- avg_days_per_year %>% filter(year == 2020)
avg_days_2021 <- avg_days_per_year %>% filter(year == 2021)
avg_days_2022 <- avg_days_per_year %>% filter(year == 2022)
avg_days_2023 <- avg_days_per_year %>% filter(year == 2023)


# Function to process data for a single year
process_year <- function(year_input) {
  data_year <- reservation_data %>% filter(year == year_input)
  
  unique_visits <- data_year %>%
    filter(!is.na(CheckinDate)) %>%
    distinct(id, parkname, CheckinDate) %>%
    group_by(id, parkname) %>%
    summarize(VisitCount = n(), .groups = "drop")
  
  all_combinations <- expand.grid(
    id = unique(data_year$id),
    parkname = unique(data_year$parkname),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  visit_data <- all_combinations %>%
    left_join(unique_visits, by = c("id", "parkname")) %>%
    mutate(VisitCount = ifelse(is.na(VisitCount), 0, VisitCount))
  
  person_info <- data_year %>%
    select(id, Permittee, zip, Zip, NoOfGuests, days_visited, year) %>%
    distinct()
  
  long_resdata_count <- left_join(visit_data, person_info, by = "id")
  
  long_resdata_count <- long_resdata_count %>%
    mutate(island_park = case_when(
      parkname == "Ainapo Cabin" ~ "Hawaii",
      parkname == "Hipalau" ~ "Kauai",
      parkname == "Kaluahaulu" ~ "Kauai",
      parkname == "Kamananui Trail" ~ "Oahu",
      parkname == "Kaunala Trail" ~ "Oahu",
      parkname == "Kawaikoi" ~ "Kauai",
      parkname == "Keanakolu Ranger & Bunkhouse Cabins" ~ "Hawaii",
      parkname == "Kuaokala Trail" ~ "Oahu",
      parkname == "Kulanaahane Trail" ~ "Oahu",
      parkname == "Kuliouou Trail" ~ "Oahu",
      parkname == "Lonomea" ~ "Kauai",
      parkname == "Maakua Ridge Trail" ~ "Oahu",
      parkname == "Manana Trail" ~ "Oahu",
      parkname == "Peacock Flats Campsite" ~ "Oahu",
      parkname == "Sugi Grove" ~ "Kauai",
      parkname == "Waialae Cabin Campsite" ~ "Kauai",
      parkname == "Waikoali" ~ "Kauai",
      parkname == "Waikolu" ~ "Molokai",
      parkname == "Waimano Trail" ~ "Oahu",
      parkname == "Waimanu Campsite" ~ "Hawaii",
      parkname == "Wiliwili" ~ "Kauai",
      parkname == "Wiliwilinui Ridge Trail" ~ "Oahu",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ))
  
  long_resdata_count <- long_resdata_count[order(long_resdata_count$id, long_resdata_count$parkname), ]
  long_resdata_count$parkname_numeric <- as.integer(factor(long_resdata_count$parkname, levels = unique(long_resdata_count$parkname)))
  
  long_resdata_count <- long_resdata_count %>%
    distinct(id, parkname, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  final_data <- long_resdata_count %>%
    left_join(
      intra_island_distance %>%
        select(zip, parkname, income, residents_distance_meters, residents_duration, island_live),
      by = c("zip", "parkname")
    )
  
  final_data <- final_data %>%
    group_by(id) %>%
    mutate(visited_another_island = ifelse(any(island_park != island_live & VisitCount > 0), 1, 0)) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  final_data$travel_distance_km <- (final_data$residents_distance_meters / 1000) * 2
  
  
  return(final_data)
}

# Run the function for each year
final_data_2018 <- process_year(2018)
final_data_2019 <- process_year(2019)
final_data_2020 <- process_year(2020)
final_data_2021 <- process_year(2021)
final_data_2022 <- process_year(2022)
final_data_2023 <- process_year(2023)

# Add correct avg_days_visited for each year by joining on id

final_data_2018 <- final_data_2018 %>%
  left_join(avg_days_2018 %>% select(id, avg_days_visited), by = "id") %>%
  mutate(days_visited = avg_days_visited)

final_data_2019 <- final_data_2019 %>%
  left_join(avg_days_2019 %>% select(id, avg_days_visited), by = "id") %>%
  mutate(days_visited = avg_days_visited)

final_data_2020 <- final_data_2020 %>%
  left_join(avg_days_2020 %>% select(id, avg_days_visited), by = "id") %>%
  mutate(days_visited = avg_days_visited)

final_data_2021 <- final_data_2021 %>%
  left_join(avg_days_2021 %>% select(id, avg_days_visited), by = "id") %>%
  mutate(days_visited = avg_days_visited)

final_data_2022 <- final_data_2022 %>%
  left_join(avg_days_2022 %>% select(id, avg_days_visited), by = "id") %>%
  mutate(days_visited = avg_days_visited)

final_data_2023 <- final_data_2023 %>%
  left_join(avg_days_2023 %>% select(id, avg_days_visited), by = "id") %>%
  mutate(days_visited = avg_days_visited)

## Travel cost per year calculations ##


##Adjusted for inflation
gas_prices <- data.frame(
  year = c(2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023),
  gas_price = c(4.68, 4.49, 4.09, 4.75, 5.81, 5.09)
)

mean_gas_price <- (4.68+4.49+4.09+4.75+5.81+5.09)/6


# Inputs based on AAA Brochure 2018
fuel_efficiency_mpg <- 25
gas_price_hawaii_2018 <- 4.68  # in USD/gallon
maintenance_per_mile <- 0.0858*1.2816  # in USD/mile 2025 price
annual_miles <- 15000
annual_ownership_cost <- 6202*1.2816  # USD 2025 price

# Calculate total cost per mile
cost_per_mile <- (
  (1 / fuel_efficiency_mpg * gas_price_hawaii_2018 * annual_miles) +  # fuel cost
    (maintenance_per_mile * annual_miles) +                             # maintenance
    annual_ownership_cost                                               # ownership
) / annual_miles  # divide by miles to get per-mile cost

library(readr)
 
# ---- ADDED: year-keyed storage so mdcev_mle / policies / data_model survive
# past the year that created them. Everything else below is your original
# code, unchanged, with one extra line after each year's model and policies
# are built. ----
mdcev_model_list <- list()
policies_list     <- list()
data_model_list   <- list()
 
#############
# 2018 model #
#############
 
aggregate(cbind(VisitCount, price) ~ parkname, data = final_data_2018, FUN = mean )
 
##Total number of visits to the most popular site
final_data_2018 %>%
  filter(parkname == "Peacock Flats Campsite") %>%
  summarise(total_visits = sum(VisitCount))
 
data_mdcev <- mdcev.data(final_data_2018,
                         id.var = "id",
                         alt.var = "parkname",
                         choice = "VisitCount")
 
args(mdcev)
 
f1 = ~ 0
 
data_model <- mdcev.data(final_data_2018,
                         id.var = "id",
                         alt.var = "parkname",
                         choice = "VisitCount")
data_model_list[["2018"]] <- data_model   # ADDED
 
##Estimate model
mdcev_mle <- mdcev(~ 1,
                   data = data_model,
                   model = "gamma", #test with hybrid instead of gamma
                   algorithm = "MLE",
                   std_errors = "mvn",
                   n_draws = 100,
                   trunc_data = 1,
                   print_iterations = TRUE)
mdcev_model_list[["2018"]] <- mdcev_mle   # ADDED
 
summary(mdcev_mle)
 
 
## Policy simulation
nalts <- mdcev_mle$stan_data[["J"]]  # Should be 21
 
npols <- 22  # 21 individual site closures + 1 for closing all
 
# Create blank policies
policies <- CreateBlankPolicies(npols = npols,
                                model = mdcev_mle,
                                price_change_only = TRUE)
 
# Set price extremely high to simulate closure for each individual site (sites 1 to 21)
for (i in 1:21) {
  # +1 to skip the numeraire in position 1
  policies$price_p[[i]][i + 1] <- 999999
}
 
# Policy 22: Close all 21 sites
# The price vector has length = nalts + 1 (includes numeraire)
policies$price_p[[22]] <- c(0, rep(999999, nalts))
 
# Check lengths for safety (optional but recommended)
stopifnot(all(sapply(policies$price_p, length) == nalts + 1))
policies_list[["2018"]] <- policies   # ADDED
 
# Prepare data for simulation
df_sim <- PrepareSimulationData(mdcev_mle, policies)
 
# Run simulation
welfare_2018 <- mdcev.sim(df_sim$df_indiv,
                     df_common = df_sim$df_common,
                     sim_options = df_sim$sim_options,
                     cond_err = 1,
                     nerrs = 100,
                     draw_mlhs = 1,
                     sim_type = "welfare")
 
# Optional: Custom summary printer
print.summary.mdcev.sim <- function(x, digits = max(3, getOption("digits") - 2),
                                    width = getOption("width"),
                                    ...) {
  print(x$CoefTable, digits = digits, n = Inf)
  invisible(x)
}
 
# View results
summary(welfare_2018)

# Loop through each item and save the summary as CSV
for (year in names(welfare_list)) {
  welfare_obj <- welfare_list[[year]]
 
  # Get summary and extract the coefficient table
  welfare_summary <- summary(welfare_obj)$CoefTable
 
  # Save to CSV
  write.csv(welfare_summary,
            file = paste0("welfare_summary_", year, ".csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)
}
 
 
 
############## Create individual-specific mean value per site 2018 ##############
 
# Step 1: Get unique IDs from final_data_2018 in the same order
unique_ids <- unique(final_data_2018$id)
unique_zips <- final_data_2018 %>%
  distinct(id, zip) %>%
  arrange(match(id, unique_ids))  # Ensure same order as IDs
 
# Step 2: Create updated welfare_2018_ind with real IDs and ZIPs
welfare_2018_ind <- data.frame(individual = integer(),
                               site = integer(),
                               mean_value = numeric(),
                               id = integer(),
                               zip = character())
 
for (i in seq_along(welfare_2018)) {
  individual_matrix <- welfare_2018[[i]]
  mean_values <- apply(individual_matrix, 2, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
 
  individual_df <- data.frame(
    individual = rep(i, length(mean_values)),              # Sequential index (not used anymore)
    site = seq_along(mean_values),
    mean_value = mean_values,
    id = rep(unique_ids[i], length(mean_values)),          # Actual id
    zip = rep(unique_zips$zip[i], length(mean_values))     # Corresponding zip
  )
 
  welfare_2018_ind <- rbind(welfare_2018_ind, individual_df)
}
 
# Optional: Drop the 'individual' column if only real id is needed
welfare_2018_ind$individual <- NULL

SATIATION 2x & 4x

Satiation multiply every translation parameter (gamma) by 2, and by 4 (doubling twice). Uses the previous data from mdcev_model_list

Show code 
# Satiation multiply every translation parameter (gamma) by 2, and by 4 (doubling twice).


stopifnot(all(c("n_psi", "n_gamma") %in% names(mdcev_model_list[["2018"]]$parms_info$n_vars)))

MULTS       <- c(2, 4)          # 2 = gamma doubled; 4 = doubled
YEARS       <- 2018:2023        # start with 2018, then widen
NERRS       <- 100              # same as the 100x run; 
FORCE_RERUN <- FALSE

scale_gamma <- function(mle_obj, multiplier) {
  n_psi   <- mle_obj$parms_info$n_vars$n_psi
  n_gamma <- mle_obj$parms_info$n_vars$n_gamma
  gamma_cols <- (n_psi + 1):(n_psi + n_gamma)

  orig_gamma <- as.numeric(mle_obj$stan_fit$par$gamma)
  new_gamma  <- orig_gamma * multiplier

  out <- mle_obj
  out$stan_fit$par$gamma[1, ] <- new_gamma
  out$stan_fit$theta_tilde[, gamma_cols] <-
    matrix(new_gamma, nrow = nrow(out$stan_fit$theta_tilde),
           ncol = length(new_gamma), byrow = TRUE)
  out
}

extract_ind <- function(w, yr, mult) {
  yr_chr <- as.character(yr)
  ids <- data_model_list[[yr_chr]] %>% as.data.frame() %>% distinct(id) %>% pull(id)
  alts <- mdcev_model_list[[yr_chr]]$parms_info$alt_names
  site_lookup <- data.frame(site = seq_len(length(alts) + 1),
                            parkname = c(alts, "Stay_Home"))        # last policy = close every campsite
  stopifnot(length(w) == length(ids))
  imap_dfr(w, function(m, i) {
    mv <- apply(m, 2, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
    data.frame(site = seq_along(mv), mean_value = mv, id = ids[as.integer(i)])
  }) %>%
    left_join(site_lookup, by = "site") %>%
    filter(!is.na(parkname)) %>%
    transmute(id = as.character(id), parkname, year = yr, multiplier = mult, loss = mean_value)
}

results <- list()

for (mult in MULTS) {
  for (yr in YEARS) {
    yr_chr <- as.character(yr)
    f  <- paste0("welfare_", yr, "_x", mult, ".rds")
    t0 <- Sys.time()

    ok <- tryCatch({
      if (file.exists(f) && !FORCE_RERUN) {
        message(">>> ", yr, " gamma x", mult, ": loading saved run")
        w <- readRDS(f)
      } else {
        message(">>> ", yr, " gamma x", mult, ": simulating (", NERRS, " draws per person) ...")
        this_mle <- mdcev_model_list[[yr_chr]]
        scaled   <- scale_gamma(this_mle, mult)
        stopifnot(identical(scaled$parms_info$alt_names, this_mle$parms_info$alt_names))
        message("    gamma before -> after (first 3): ",
                paste(round(head(as.numeric(this_mle$stan_fit$par$gamma), 3), 2), collapse = ", "), "  ->  ",
                paste(round(head(as.numeric(scaled$stan_fit$par$gamma), 3), 2), collapse = ", "))
        ds <- PrepareSimulationData(scaled, policies_list[[yr_chr]])
        set.seed(3000 + yr)
        w <- mdcev.sim(ds$df_indiv, df_common = ds$df_common, sim_options = ds$sim_options,
                       cond_err = 1, nerrs = NERRS, draw_mlhs = 1, sim_type = "welfare")
        saveRDS(w, f)  # raw run saved first
      }
      ind <- extract_ind(w, yr, mult)
      results[[paste(yr, mult)]] <- ind
      assign(paste0("welfare_", yr, "_x", mult, "_ind"), ind, envir = .GlobalEnv)
      TRUE
    }, error = function(e) { message("  !!! ", yr, " x", mult, " failed: ", conditionMessage(e)); FALSE })

    message("    ", yr, " x", mult, if (ok) " done" else " FAILED", " in ",
            round(as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "mins")), 1), " minutes")
  }
}

sat_mult_all <- bind_rows(results)
stopifnot(nrow(sat_mult_all) > 0, !anyDuplicated(sat_mult_all[c("id", "parkname", "year", "multiplier")]))

# ---- Merge onto the master as loss_mdcev_x2, loss_mdcev_x4, ... ------------------------------------

McFaddenR2

The mlogit gives NA so running manually to calculate McFadden to double check the R2

and it above .2 so that great

Show code 
# 1. Estimate your model (The "Full" model)
rum_full <- mlogit(choice ~ price | 1, data = df_rum)

# 2. Estimate the "Null" model (Intersects only, no price)
# Use '0' for the first part of the formula to remove choice-specific variables
rum_null <- mlogit(choice ~ 0 | 1, data = df_rum)

# 3. Use the lrtest function to get your Chi-square and p-value

lr_test_result <- lrtest(rum_full, rum_null)
print(lr_test_result)

# 4. Calculate McFadden's R-squared manually
ll_full <- as.numeric(logLik(rum_full))
ll_null <- as.numeric(logLik(rum_null))
mcfadden_r2 <- 1 - (ll_full / ll_null)

print(paste("Manual McFadden R2:", round(mcfadden_r2, 4)))

Per person 52-weeks

This section assumes that there are 52 decisions for an indivudal and that they choose to camp or not. We assume the times visit is a choice.

Show code 
years <- 2018:2023
N_KR  <- 1000                                    # Krinsky-Robb draws
 
model_list_52    <- list()
mcfadden_list_52 <- list()
kr_list_52       <- list()                    # Krinsky-Robb draws per year
week_diag_52    <- list()                    
 
## give each trip a week, at most one trip per week. pref = preferred (calendar) week, whose week is taken goes to the nearest free week (the earlier one on a tie). Undated trips go to the first free week.

assign_weeks <- function(pref) {
  n <- length(pref)
  if (n > 52) stop("a camper has more than 52 trips; cannot place one trip per week")
  out <- rep(NA_integer_, n); used <- logical(52)
  for (k in order(is.na(pref), pref)) {
    w <- if (is.na(pref[k])) 1L else as.integer(pref[k])
    if (used[w]) { free <- which(!used); w <- free[which.min(abs(free - w))] }
    out[k] <- w; used[w] <- TRUE
  }
  out
}
 
# --- Main Loop ---
final_comparison_52_person <- map_df(years, function(yr) {
 
  message(paste(">>> Processing Year (52-week, Stay_Home reference):", yr))
  current_data <- get(paste0("final_data_", yr))
 
  unique_users <- current_data %>%
    group_by(id) %>%
    summarise(zip = first(zip), income = first(income), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(id = as.character(id))
 
  all_parks <- unique(current_data$parkname)

  dated <- reservation_data %>%
    filter(year == yr, !is.na(CheckinDate)) %>%
    mutate(id = as.character(id)) %>%
    distinct(id, parkname, CheckinDate) %>%
    mutate(week = pmin(as.integer(format(as.Date(CheckinDate), "%U")) + 1, 52)) %>%
    arrange(id, parkname, CheckinDate) %>%
    group_by(id, parkname) %>% mutate(k = row_number()) %>% ungroup()
 
  trips <- current_data %>%
    mutate(id = as.character(id)) %>%
    filter(VisitCount > 0) %>%
    select(id, parkname, VisitCount) %>%
    uncount(VisitCount, .id = "k") %>%
    left_join(dated %>% select(id, parkname, k, pref_week = week),
              by = c("id", "parkname", "k")) %>%
    group_by(id) %>%
    mutate(week = assign_weeks(pref_week)) %>%
    ungroup()
 
  ## checks: one trip per camper-week, and trips per camper-park equal VisitCount
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(trips[, c("id", "week")]))
  chk <- trips %>% count(id, parkname, name = "n_trips") %>%
    full_join(current_data %>% mutate(id = as.character(id)) %>% filter(VisitCount > 0) %>%
                select(id, parkname, VisitCount), by = c("id", "parkname"))
  stopifnot(all(chk$n_trips == chk$VisitCount))
 
  week_diag_52[[as.character(yr)]] <<- data.frame(
    year              = yr,
    trips             = nrow(trips),
    on_calendar_week  = sum(!is.na(trips$pref_week) & trips$week == trips$pref_week),
    moved             = sum(!is.na(trips$pref_week) & trips$week != trips$pref_week),
    no_reservation    = sum(is.na(trips$pref_week)),
    unused_reservations = nrow(dated) - sum(!is.na(trips$pref_week))
  )
  print(week_diag_52[[as.character(yr)]], row.names = FALSE)
 
  df_52_weeks <- unique_users %>%
    expand_grid(week = 1:52) %>%
    mutate(choice_id = paste0(id, "_w", week))
 
  weekly_panel <- df_52_weeks %>%
    left_join(trips %>% select(id, week, chosen_park = parkname), by = c("id", "week")) %>%
    mutate(chosen_park = replace_na(chosen_park, "Stay_Home"))
  stopifnot(nrow(weekly_panel) == nrow(df_52_weeks))
 
  assign(paste0("final_data_", yr, "_rum"), weekly_panel, envir = .GlobalEnv)
 
  # --- Build the full choice set (one row per person-week-alternative) ---
  df_rum_final <- weekly_panel %>%
    expand_grid(parkname = c(all_parks, "Stay_Home")) %>%
    mutate(choice = (chosen_park == parkname)) %>%
    left_join(current_data %>% mutate(id = as.character(id)) %>% select(id, parkname, price),
              by = c("id", "parkname")) %>%
    mutate(price = ifelse(parkname == "Stay_Home", 0, price))
  stopifnot(!anyNA(df_rum_final$price))
 
  df_idx_local <- dfidx(df_rum_final, idx = list("choice_id", "parkname"), shape = "long")
 
  ##  Stay_Home is the reference alternative (its constant is fixed at 0)
  rum_mle_52 <- tryCatch({
    mlogit(choice ~ price | 1, data = df_idx_local, reflevel = "Stay_Home", method = "nr")
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("NR Solver failed, trying BHHH...")
    mlogit(choice ~ price | 1, data = df_idx_local, reflevel = "Stay_Home", method = "bhhh")
  })
 
  model_list_52[[paste("52wk", yr)]] <<- rum_mle_52
 
  rum_null <- mlogit(choice ~ 1 | 1, data = df_idx_local, reflevel = "Stay_Home")
  ll_mod  <- as.numeric(logLik(rum_mle_52))
  ll_null <- as.numeric(logLik(rum_null))
  mcf_r2  <- 1 - (ll_mod / ll_null)
  mcfadden_list_52[[paste("52weeks", yr)]] <<- format(round(mcf_r2, 3), nsmall = 3)
 
  # --- CHANGED: welfare from one occasion per camper ----------------------
  X   <- model.matrix(rum_mle_52)
  oid <- as.character(idx(df_idx_local, 1)); alt <- as.character(idx(df_idx_local, 2))
  alts <- unique(alt); K <- length(alts)
  stopifnot(nrow(X) == length(oid), all(alt == rep(alts, length(unique(oid)))))
  first <- grepl("_w1$", oid) # week 1 of every camper
  X1    <- X[first, , drop = FALSE]
  pid   <- sub("_w1$", "", oid[first][seq(1, sum(first), by = K)])
  sites <- sort(all_parks)
  site_cols <- match(sites, alts); home_col <- match("Stay_Home", alts)
  stopifnot(!anyNA(site_cols), !is.na(home_col))
 
  ## annual losses per camper (campers x policies) for coefficient vector b
  person_loss <- function(b) {
    V  <- matrix(X1 %*% b[colnames(X1)], ncol = K, byrow = TRUE)
    P  <- exp(V - apply(V, 1, max)); P <- P / rowSums(P)
    bp <- -b[["price"]]
    L  <- 52 * log(1 - P[, site_cols, drop = FALSE]) / bp        # close one site
    colnames(L) <- sites
    cbind(L, "All sites closed" = 52 * log(P[, home_col]) / bp)  # only Stay_Home left
  }
  ## means per camper
  welf_summary <- function(b) {
    L <- person_loss(b); site <- L[, sites, drop = FALSE]
    c(colMeans(site),
      "Sum of single-site losses" = mean(rowSums(site)),
      "All sites closed"          = mean(L[, "All sites closed"]),
      "Average site closure"      = mean(colMeans(site)))
  }
 
  # ---  Krinsky-Robb ----------------------------------------------
  set.seed(898989 + yr)                                      
  draws <- MASS::mvrnorm(N_KR, coef(rum_mle_52), vcov(rum_mle_52))  
  kr <- t(apply(draws, 1, welf_summary))
  pt <- welf_summary(coef(rum_mle_52))
  kr_summary <- data.frame(measure = names(pt), mean = pt,
                           lower = apply(kr, 2, quantile, 0.025),
                           upper = apply(kr, 2, quantile, 0.975),
                           row.names = NULL)
  kr_list_52[[paste("52wk", yr)]] <<- list(summary = kr_summary, draws = kr)
  print(kr_summary, digits = 4, row.names = FALSE)
 
  # --- per-person point estimates (same output as before) -----------------
  Lp <- person_loss(coef(rum_mle_52))
  rum_person_results <- data.frame(
    id              = rep(pid, ncol(Lp)),
    annual_rum_loss = as.vector(Lp),
    parkname        = rep(colnames(Lp), each = nrow(Lp))
  )
 
  year_comparison <- rum_person_results %>%
    left_join(unique_users, by = "id") %>%
    mutate(year = yr)
 
  return(year_comparison)
})
 

saveRDS(model_list_52, "data/model_list_52.rds")
saveRDS(kr_list_52,    "data/kr_list_52.rds")

# 1. Extract the Price Coefficient
beta_price <- coef(rum_mle)["price"]
model_list_52 <- readRDS("data/model_list_52.rds")
# 2. Calculate Total System Welfare Loss
# We compare the current state (All Parks) to the "Closed" state (Stay_Home Only)
total_system_welfare <- df_math %>%
  group_by(trip_id) %>%
  summarise(
    # Inclusive value (Log-Sum) of the current world:
    ls_base = log(sum(exp(V))),
    
    # Inclusive value if ONLY 'Stay_Home' exists (Everything else removed):
    ls_policy = log(sum(exp(V[park_name == "Stay_Home"]))),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # Welfare formula: (LS_policy - LS_base) / -beta_price
  mutate(cv_week = (ls_policy - ls_base) / -beta_price) %>%
  
  # Group by User ID to get the Annual Total
  mutate(id = as.character(str_remove(trip_id, "_w\\d+$"))) %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarise(annual_system_loss = sum(cv_week, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# 3. View the Results
summary_stats <- total_system_welfare %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Annual_Value = mean(annual_system_loss),
    Median_Annual_Value = median(annual_system_loss),
    Total_Sample_Value = sum(annual_system_loss)
  )

print(summary_stats)

years <- 2018:2023
 
# ---- Baseline MDCEV: welfare_YYYY_ind from mdcev_pipeline_with_year_lists.R
# does NOT have parkname joined yet (that script left the original
# extraction loop untouched) -- join it here from each year's own model,
# same pattern as the satiation-off extraction already uses. ----
mdcev_baseline_all <- map_df(years, function(yr) {
  yr_chr <- as.character(yr)
  alt_names_yr <- mdcev_model_list[[yr_chr]]$parms_info$alt_names
  nalts <- length(alt_names_yr)
  site_lookup <- data.frame(
    site     = seq_len(nalts + 1),
    parkname = c(alt_names_yr, "Close_All")
  )
 
  get(paste0("welfare_", yr, "_ind")) %>%
    left_join(site_lookup, by = "site") %>%
    filter(!is.na(parkname)) %>%
    mutate(
      id       = as.character(id),
      year     = yr,
      parkname = ifelse(parkname == "Close_All", "Stay_Home", parkname)
    ) %>%
    select(id, parkname, year, zip, loss_mdcev = mean_value)
})

```{r}
# Load datasets
reservation_data <- read_dta("data/reservation_data_merged_id_complete.dta")
intra_island_distance <- read.csv("data/intra_island_distance2.csv")

# Add year
reservation_data$year <- as.numeric(format(as.Date(reservation_data$CheckinDate, "%Y-%m-%d"), "%Y"))

reservation_data <- reservation_data %>%
  mutate(zip = ifelse(zip == 96812, 96813, zip))

# Group and compute yearly averages
avg_days_per_year <- reservation_data %>%
  group_by(year, id) %>%
  summarize(avg_days_visited = mean(days_visited, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

avg_days_2018 <- avg_days_per_year %>% filter(year == 2018)
avg_days_2019 <- avg_days_per_year %>% filter(year == 2019)
avg_days_2020 <- avg_days_per_year %>% filter(year == 2020)
avg_days_2021 <- avg_days_per_year %>% filter(year == 2021)
avg_days_2022 <- avg_days_per_year %>% filter(year == 2022)
avg_days_2023 <- avg_days_per_year %>% filter(year == 2023)


# Function to process data for a single year
process_year <- function(year_input) {
  data_year <- reservation_data %>% filter(year == year_input)
  
  unique_visits <- data_year %>%
    filter(!is.na(CheckinDate)) %>%
    distinct(id, parkname, CheckinDate) %>%
    group_by(id, parkname) %>%
    summarize(VisitCount = n(), .groups = "drop")
  
  all_combinations <- expand.grid(
    id = unique(data_year$id),
    parkname = unique(data_year$parkname),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  visit_data <- all_combinations %>%
    left_join(unique_visits, by = c("id", "parkname")) %>%
    mutate(VisitCount = ifelse(is.na(VisitCount), 0, VisitCount))
  
  person_info <- data_year %>%
    select(id, Permittee, zip, Zip, NoOfGuests, days_visited, year) %>%
    distinct()
  
  long_resdata_count <- left_join(visit_data, person_info, by = "id")
  
  long_resdata_count <- long_resdata_count %>%
    mutate(island_park = case_when(
      parkname == "Ainapo Cabin" ~ "Hawaii",
      parkname == "Hipalau" ~ "Kauai",
      parkname == "Kaluahaulu" ~ "Kauai",
      parkname == "Kamananui Trail" ~ "Oahu",
      parkname == "Kaunala Trail" ~ "Oahu",
      parkname == "Kawaikoi" ~ "Kauai",
      parkname == "Keanakolu Ranger & Bunkhouse Cabins" ~ "Hawaii",
      parkname == "Kuaokala Trail" ~ "Oahu",
      parkname == "Kulanaahane Trail" ~ "Oahu",
      parkname == "Kuliouou Trail" ~ "Oahu",
      parkname == "Lonomea" ~ "Kauai",
      parkname == "Maakua Ridge Trail" ~ "Oahu",
      parkname == "Manana Trail" ~ "Oahu",
      parkname == "Peacock Flats Campsite" ~ "Oahu",
      parkname == "Sugi Grove" ~ "Kauai",
      parkname == "Waialae Cabin Campsite" ~ "Kauai",
      parkname == "Waikoali" ~ "Kauai",
      parkname == "Waikolu" ~ "Molokai",
      parkname == "Waimano Trail" ~ "Oahu",
      parkname == "Waimanu Campsite" ~ "Hawaii",
      parkname == "Wiliwili" ~ "Kauai",
      parkname == "Wiliwilinui Ridge Trail" ~ "Oahu",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ))
  
  long_resdata_count <- long_resdata_count[order(long_resdata_count$id, long_resdata_count$parkname), ]
  long_resdata_count$parkname_numeric <- as.integer(factor(long_resdata_count$parkname, levels = unique(long_resdata_count$parkname)))
  
  long_resdata_count <- long_resdata_count %>%
    distinct(id, parkname, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  final_data <- long_resdata_count %>%
    left_join(
      intra_island_distance %>%
        select(zip, parkname, income, residents_distance_meters, residents_duration, island_live),
      by = c("zip", "parkname")
    )
  
  final_data <- final_data %>%
    group_by(id) %>%
    mutate(visited_another_island = ifelse(any(island_park != island_live & VisitCount > 0), 1, 0)) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  final_data$travel_distance_km <- (final_data$residents_distance_meters / 1000) * 2
  
  
  return(final_data)
}

# Run the function for each year
final_data_2018 <- process_year(2018)
final_data_2019 <- process_year(2019)
final_data_2020 <- process_year(2020)
final_data_2021 <- process_year(2021)
final_data_2022 <- process_year(2022)
final_data_2023 <- process_year(2023)

# Add correct avg_days_visited for each year by joining on id

final_data_2018 <- final_data_2018 %>%
  left_join(avg_days_2018 %>% select(id, avg_days_visited), by = "id") %>%
  mutate(days_visited = avg_days_visited)

final_data_2019 <- final_data_2019 %>%
  left_join(avg_days_2019 %>% select(id, avg_days_visited), by = "id") %>%
  mutate(days_visited = avg_days_visited)

final_data_2020 <- final_data_2020 %>%
  left_join(avg_days_2020 %>% select(id, avg_days_visited), by = "id") %>%
  mutate(days_visited = avg_days_visited)

final_data_2021 <- final_data_2021 %>%
  left_join(avg_days_2021 %>% select(id, avg_days_visited), by = "id") %>%
  mutate(days_visited = avg_days_visited)

final_data_2022 <- final_data_2022 %>%
  left_join(avg_days_2022 %>% select(id, avg_days_visited), by = "id") %>%
  mutate(days_visited = avg_days_visited)

final_data_2023 <- final_data_2023 %>%
  left_join(avg_days_2023 %>% select(id, avg_days_visited), by = "id") %>%
  mutate(days_visited = avg_days_visited)

## Travel cost per year calculations ##


##Adjusted for inflation
gas_prices <- data.frame(
  year = c(2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023),
  gas_price = c(4.68, 4.49, 4.09, 4.75, 5.81, 5.09)
)

mean_gas_price <- (4.68+4.49+4.09+4.75+5.81+5.09)/6


# Inputs based on AAA Brochure 2018
fuel_efficiency_mpg <- 25
gas_price_hawaii_2018 <- 4.68  # in USD/gallon
maintenance_per_mile <- 0.0858*1.2816  # in USD/mile 2025 price
annual_miles <- 15000
annual_ownership_cost <- 6202*1.2816  # USD 2025 price

# Calculate total cost per mile
cost_per_mile <- (
  (1 / fuel_efficiency_mpg * gas_price_hawaii_2018 * annual_miles) +  # fuel cost
    (maintenance_per_mile * annual_miles) +                             # maintenance
    annual_ownership_cost                                               # ownership
) / annual_miles  # divide by miles to get per-mile cost
```

# MDVEC
```{r}
#| eval: false    
#| echo: true 

#Mdcev pipeline with year lists · R
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(rmdcev)
library(haven)
library(readr)
 
# ---- ADDED: year-keyed storage so mdcev_mle / policies / data_model survive
# past the year that created them. Everything else below is your original
# code, unchanged, with one extra line after each year's model and policies
# are built. ----
mdcev_model_list <- list()
policies_list     <- list()
data_model_list   <- list()
 
#############
# 2018 model #
#############
 
aggregate(cbind(VisitCount, price) ~ parkname, data = final_data_2018, FUN = mean )
 
##Total number of visits to the most popular site
final_data_2018 %>%
  filter(parkname == "Peacock Flats Campsite") %>%
  summarise(total_visits = sum(VisitCount))
 
data_mdcev <- mdcev.data(final_data_2018,
                         id.var = "id",
                         alt.var = "parkname",
                         choice = "VisitCount")
 
args(mdcev)
 
f1 = ~ 0
 
data_model <- mdcev.data(final_data_2018,
                         id.var = "id",
                         alt.var = "parkname",
                         choice = "VisitCount")
data_model_list[["2018"]] <- data_model   # ADDED
 
##Estimate model
mdcev_mle <- mdcev(~ 1,
                   data = data_model,
                   model = "gamma", #test with hybrid instead of gamma
                   algorithm = "MLE",
                   std_errors = "mvn",
                   n_draws = 100,
                   trunc_data = 1,
                   print_iterations = TRUE)
mdcev_model_list[["2018"]] <- mdcev_mle   # ADDED
 
summary(mdcev_mle)
 
 
## Policy simulation
nalts <- mdcev_mle$stan_data[["J"]]  # Should be 21
 
npols <- 22  # 21 individual site closures + 1 for closing all
 
# Create blank policies
policies <- CreateBlankPolicies(npols = npols,
                                model = mdcev_mle,
                                price_change_only = TRUE)
 
# Set price extremely high to simulate closure for each individual site (sites 1 to 21)
for (i in 1:21) {
  # +1 to skip the numeraire in position 1
  policies$price_p[[i]][i + 1] <- 999999
}
 
# Policy 22: Close all 21 sites
# The price vector has length = nalts + 1 (includes numeraire)
policies$price_p[[22]] <- c(0, rep(999999, nalts))
 
# Check lengths for safety (optional but recommended)
stopifnot(all(sapply(policies$price_p, length) == nalts + 1))
policies_list[["2018"]] <- policies   # ADDED
 
# Prepare data for simulation
df_sim <- PrepareSimulationData(mdcev_mle, policies)
 
# Run simulation
welfare_2018 <- mdcev.sim(df_sim$df_indiv,
                     df_common = df_sim$df_common,
                     sim_options = df_sim$sim_options,
                     cond_err = 1,
                     nerrs = 100,
                     draw_mlhs = 1,
                     sim_type = "welfare")
 
# Optional: Custom summary printer
print.summary.mdcev.sim <- function(x, digits = max(3, getOption("digits") - 2),
                                    width = getOption("width"),
                                    ...) {
  print(x$CoefTable, digits = digits, n = Inf)
  invisible(x)
}
 
# View results
summary(welfare_2018)

# 2019 model #
#############
```

#### SATIATION 2x & 4x
Satiation multiply every translation parameter (gamma) by 2, and by 4 (doubling twice). Uses the previous data from mdcev_model_list
```{r}
#| eval: false    
#| echo: true 
# Satiation multiply every translation parameter (gamma) by 2, and by 4 (doubling twice).


stopifnot(all(c("n_psi", "n_gamma") %in% names(mdcev_model_list[["2018"]]$parms_info$n_vars)))

MULTS       <- c(2, 4)          # 2 = gamma doubled; 4 = doubled
YEARS       <- 2018:2023        # start with 2018, then widen
NERRS       <- 100              # same as the 100x run; 
FORCE_RERUN <- FALSE

scale_gamma <- function(mle_obj, multiplier) {
  n_psi   <- mle_obj$parms_info$n_vars$n_psi
  n_gamma <- mle_obj$parms_info$n_vars$n_gamma
  gamma_cols <- (n_psi + 1):(n_psi + n_gamma)

  orig_gamma <- as.numeric(mle_obj$stan_fit$par$gamma)
  new_gamma  <- orig_gamma * multiplier

  out <- mle_obj
  out$stan_fit$par$gamma[1, ] <- new_gamma
  out$stan_fit$theta_tilde[, gamma_cols] <-
    matrix(new_gamma, nrow = nrow(out$stan_fit$theta_tilde),
           ncol = length(new_gamma), byrow = TRUE)
  out
}

extract_ind <- function(w, yr, mult) {
  yr_chr <- as.character(yr)
  ids <- data_model_list[[yr_chr]] %>% as.data.frame() %>% distinct(id) %>% pull(id)
  alts <- mdcev_model_list[[yr_chr]]$parms_info$alt_names
  site_lookup <- data.frame(site = seq_len(length(alts) + 1),
                            parkname = c(alts, "Stay_Home"))        # last policy = close every campsite
  stopifnot(length(w) == length(ids))
  imap_dfr(w, function(m, i) {
    mv <- apply(m, 2, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
    data.frame(site = seq_along(mv), mean_value = mv, id = ids[as.integer(i)])
  }) %>%
    left_join(site_lookup, by = "site") %>%
    filter(!is.na(parkname)) %>%
    transmute(id = as.character(id), parkname, year = yr, multiplier = mult, loss = mean_value)
}

results <- list()

for (mult in MULTS) {
  for (yr in YEARS) {
    yr_chr <- as.character(yr)
    f  <- paste0("welfare_", yr, "_x", mult, ".rds")
    t0 <- Sys.time()

    ok <- tryCatch({
      if (file.exists(f) && !FORCE_RERUN) {
        message(">>> ", yr, " gamma x", mult, ": loading saved run")
        w <- readRDS(f)
      } else {
        message(">>> ", yr, " gamma x", mult, ": simulating (", NERRS, " draws per person) ...")
        this_mle <- mdcev_model_list[[yr_chr]]
        scaled   <- scale_gamma(this_mle, mult)
        stopifnot(identical(scaled$parms_info$alt_names, this_mle$parms_info$alt_names))
        message("    gamma before -> after (first 3): ",
                paste(round(head(as.numeric(this_mle$stan_fit$par$gamma), 3), 2), collapse = ", "), "  ->  ",
                paste(round(head(as.numeric(scaled$stan_fit$par$gamma), 3), 2), collapse = ", "))
        ds <- PrepareSimulationData(scaled, policies_list[[yr_chr]])
        set.seed(3000 + yr)
        w <- mdcev.sim(ds$df_indiv, df_common = ds$df_common, sim_options = ds$sim_options,
                       cond_err = 1, nerrs = NERRS, draw_mlhs = 1, sim_type = "welfare")
        saveRDS(w, f)  # raw run saved first
      }
      ind <- extract_ind(w, yr, mult)
      results[[paste(yr, mult)]] <- ind
      assign(paste0("welfare_", yr, "_x", mult, "_ind"), ind, envir = .GlobalEnv)
      TRUE
    }, error = function(e) { message("  !!! ", yr, " x", mult, " failed: ", conditionMessage(e)); FALSE })

    message("    ", yr, " x", mult, if (ok) " done" else " FAILED", " in ",
            round(as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "mins")), 1), " minutes")
  }
}

sat_mult_all <- bind_rows(results)
stopifnot(nrow(sat_mult_all) > 0, !anyDuplicated(sat_mult_all[c("id", "parkname", "year", "multiplier")]))

# ---- Merge onto the master as loss_mdcev_x2, loss_mdcev_x4, ... ------------------------------------
if (exists("final_comparison_master")) {
  wide <- sat_mult_all %>%
    mutate(col = paste0("loss_mdcev_x", multiplier)) %>%
    select(id, parkname, year, col, loss) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = col, values_from = loss)
  final_comparison_master <- final_comparison_master %>%
    mutate(id = as.character(id)) %>%
    select(-any_of(setdiff(names(wide), c("id", "parkname", "year")))) %>%   # safe to re-run
    left_join(wide, by = c("id", "parkname", "year"))
  saveRDS(final_comparison_master, "final_comparison_master_with_multipliers.rds")
}

# ---- Mean loss per campsite by year: RUM, baseline (1x), 2x and 4x  ------------------------------
if (exists("final_comparison_master")) {
  cat("\nMean loss per campsite closure (USD; negative = loss), by year and satiation multiplier:\n")
  final_comparison_master %>%
    filter(parkname != "Stay_Home") %>%
    group_by(year) %>%
    summarise(rum = mean(annual_rum_loss, na.rm = TRUE),
              x1  = mean(loss_mdcev, na.rm = TRUE),
              across(any_of(grep("^loss_mdcev_x[0-9]+$", names(final_comparison_master), value = TRUE)),
                     ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), .names = "{sub('loss_mdcev_', '', .col)}"),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(across(-year, ~ round(.x, 2))) %>%
    print(width = Inf)
}

welfare_x2_ind=rbind(welfare_2018_x2_ind,welfare_2019_x2_ind,welfare_2020_x2_ind,welfare_2021_x2_ind,welfare_2022_x2_ind,welfare_2023_x2_ind)
welfare_x4_ind=rbind(welfare_2018_x4_ind,welfare_2019_x4_ind,welfare_2020_x4_ind,welfare_2021_x4_ind,welfare_2022_x4_ind,welfare_2023_x4_ind)
```

# Rum
This function calculate the rum welfare manual and is used for each year to get a comparison to the MDCEV.

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| message: false



# Create unique choice occasions for every visit
data_rum <- final_data_2018 %>%
  filter(VisitCount > 0) %>%
  uncount(VisitCount) %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  mutate(choice_id = paste0(id, "_", row_number())) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(choice_id, id, chosen_park = parkname) %>%
  expand_grid(parkname = unique(final_data_2018$parkname)) %>%
  mutate(choice = (chosen_park == parkname)) %>%
  left_join(final_data_2018 %>% select(id, parkname, price/NoOfGuests, travel_distance_km,income,zip), 
            by = c("id", "parkname"))

# Create Stay at Home

# Create the Stay-at-Home option for every choice occasion
outside_home <- data_rum %>%
  distinct(choice_id, id,income,zip) %>%
  mutate(
    parkname = "Stay_Home",
    choice = FALSE,      
    price = 0,
    travel_distance_km = 0
  )

# Combine with your existing data
data_rum<- bind_rows(data_rum, outside_home)

# Re-format for mlogit
df_rum <- dfidx(data_rum, 
                        idx = list("choice_id", "parkname"), 
                        shape = "long")

# Simple Multinomial Logit
rum_mle <- mlogit(choice ~ price  | 1, data = df_rum)
summary(rum_mle)



# Calculate the 'Logsum' (Total Utility) for the status quo
logsum_base <- logsum(rum_mle)

# 1. Convert df_rum to a standard data frame for our math
df_math <- as.data.frame(df_rum)

# 2. Extract the IDs and Park names from the 'idx' column
# idx(df_rum, 1) gets the 'choice_id'
# idx(df_rum, 2) gets the 'parkname'
df_math$trip_id   <- as.character(idx(df_rum, 1))
df_math$park_name <- as.character(idx(df_rum, 2))

# 3. Calculate the Systematic Utility (V)
# This uses the model coefficients and the data matrix
df_math$V <- as.numeric(model.matrix(rum_mle) %*% coef(rum_mle))

# 4. Double check the columns are there
head(df_math[, c("trip_id", "park_name", "V")])



```

#### McFaddenR2

The mlogit gives NA so running manually to calculate McFadden to double check the R2

and it above .2 so that great

```{r}
#| eval: false    
#| echo: true 
# 1. Estimate your model (The "Full" model)
rum_full <- mlogit(choice ~ price | 1, data = df_rum)

# 2. Estimate the "Null" model (Intersects only, no price)
# Use '0' for the first part of the formula to remove choice-specific variables
rum_null <- mlogit(choice ~ 0 | 1, data = df_rum)

# 3. Use the lrtest function to get your Chi-square and p-value

lr_test_result <- lrtest(rum_full, rum_null)
print(lr_test_result)

# 4. Calculate McFadden's R-squared manually
ll_full <- as.numeric(logLik(rum_full))
ll_null <- as.numeric(logLik(rum_null))
mcfadden_r2 <- 1 - (ll_full / ll_null)

print(paste("Manual McFadden R2:", round(mcfadden_r2, 4)))



```



# Per person 52-weeks

This section assumes that there are 52 decisions for an indivudal and that they choose to camp or not. We assume the times visit is a choice.

```{r}
#| eval: false    
#| echo: true 
 
years <- 2018:2023
N_KR  <- 1000                                    # Krinsky-Robb draws
 
model_list_52    <- list()
mcfadden_list_52 <- list()
kr_list_52       <- list()                    # Krinsky-Robb draws per year
week_diag_52    <- list()                    
 
## give each trip a week, at most one trip per week. pref = preferred (calendar) week, whose week is taken goes to the nearest free week (the earlier one on a tie). Undated trips go to the first free week.

assign_weeks <- function(pref) {
  n <- length(pref)
  if (n > 52) stop("a camper has more than 52 trips; cannot place one trip per week")
  out <- rep(NA_integer_, n); used <- logical(52)
  for (k in order(is.na(pref), pref)) {
    w <- if (is.na(pref[k])) 1L else as.integer(pref[k])
    if (used[w]) { free <- which(!used); w <- free[which.min(abs(free - w))] }
    out[k] <- w; used[w] <- TRUE
  }
  out
}
 
# --- Main Loop ---
final_comparison_52_person <- map_df(years, function(yr) {
 
  message(paste(">>> Processing Year (52-week, Stay_Home reference):", yr))
  current_data <- get(paste0("final_data_", yr))
 
  unique_users <- current_data %>%
    group_by(id) %>%
    summarise(zip = first(zip), income = first(income), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(id = as.character(id))
 
  all_parks <- unique(current_data$parkname)

  dated <- reservation_data %>%
    filter(year == yr, !is.na(CheckinDate)) %>%
    mutate(id = as.character(id)) %>%
    distinct(id, parkname, CheckinDate) %>%
    mutate(week = pmin(as.integer(format(as.Date(CheckinDate), "%U")) + 1, 52)) %>%
    arrange(id, parkname, CheckinDate) %>%
    group_by(id, parkname) %>% mutate(k = row_number()) %>% ungroup()
 
  trips <- current_data %>%
    mutate(id = as.character(id)) %>%
    filter(VisitCount > 0) %>%
    select(id, parkname, VisitCount) %>%
    uncount(VisitCount, .id = "k") %>%
    left_join(dated %>% select(id, parkname, k, pref_week = week),
              by = c("id", "parkname", "k")) %>%
    group_by(id) %>%
    mutate(week = assign_weeks(pref_week)) %>%
    ungroup()
 
  ## checks: one trip per camper-week, and trips per camper-park equal VisitCount
  stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(trips[, c("id", "week")]))
  chk <- trips %>% count(id, parkname, name = "n_trips") %>%
    full_join(current_data %>% mutate(id = as.character(id)) %>% filter(VisitCount > 0) %>%
                select(id, parkname, VisitCount), by = c("id", "parkname"))
  stopifnot(all(chk$n_trips == chk$VisitCount))
 
  week_diag_52[[as.character(yr)]] <<- data.frame(
    year              = yr,
    trips             = nrow(trips),
    on_calendar_week  = sum(!is.na(trips$pref_week) & trips$week == trips$pref_week),
    moved             = sum(!is.na(trips$pref_week) & trips$week != trips$pref_week),
    no_reservation    = sum(is.na(trips$pref_week)),
    unused_reservations = nrow(dated) - sum(!is.na(trips$pref_week))
  )
  print(week_diag_52[[as.character(yr)]], row.names = FALSE)
 
  df_52_weeks <- unique_users %>%
    expand_grid(week = 1:52) %>%
    mutate(choice_id = paste0(id, "_w", week))
 
  weekly_panel <- df_52_weeks %>%
    left_join(trips %>% select(id, week, chosen_park = parkname), by = c("id", "week")) %>%
    mutate(chosen_park = replace_na(chosen_park, "Stay_Home"))
  stopifnot(nrow(weekly_panel) == nrow(df_52_weeks))
 
  assign(paste0("final_data_", yr, "_rum"), weekly_panel, envir = .GlobalEnv)
 
  # --- Build the full choice set (one row per person-week-alternative) ---
  df_rum_final <- weekly_panel %>%
    expand_grid(parkname = c(all_parks, "Stay_Home")) %>%
    mutate(choice = (chosen_park == parkname)) %>%
    left_join(current_data %>% mutate(id = as.character(id)) %>% select(id, parkname, price),
              by = c("id", "parkname")) %>%
    mutate(price = ifelse(parkname == "Stay_Home", 0, price))
  stopifnot(!anyNA(df_rum_final$price))
 
  df_idx_local <- dfidx(df_rum_final, idx = list("choice_id", "parkname"), shape = "long")
 
  ##  Stay_Home is the reference alternative (its constant is fixed at 0)
  rum_mle_52 <- tryCatch({
    mlogit(choice ~ price | 1, data = df_idx_local, reflevel = "Stay_Home", method = "nr")
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("NR Solver failed, trying BHHH...")
    mlogit(choice ~ price | 1, data = df_idx_local, reflevel = "Stay_Home", method = "bhhh")
  })
 
  model_list_52[[paste("52wk", yr)]] <<- rum_mle_52
 
  rum_null <- mlogit(choice ~ 1 | 1, data = df_idx_local, reflevel = "Stay_Home")
  ll_mod  <- as.numeric(logLik(rum_mle_52))
  ll_null <- as.numeric(logLik(rum_null))
  mcf_r2  <- 1 - (ll_mod / ll_null)
  mcfadden_list_52[[paste("52weeks", yr)]] <<- format(round(mcf_r2, 3), nsmall = 3)
 
  # --- CHANGED: welfare from one occasion per camper ----------------------
  X   <- model.matrix(rum_mle_52)
  oid <- as.character(idx(df_idx_local, 1)); alt <- as.character(idx(df_idx_local, 2))
  alts <- unique(alt); K <- length(alts)
  stopifnot(nrow(X) == length(oid), all(alt == rep(alts, length(unique(oid)))))
  first <- grepl("_w1$", oid) # week 1 of every camper
  X1    <- X[first, , drop = FALSE]
  pid   <- sub("_w1$", "", oid[first][seq(1, sum(first), by = K)])
  sites <- sort(all_parks)
  site_cols <- match(sites, alts); home_col <- match("Stay_Home", alts)
  stopifnot(!anyNA(site_cols), !is.na(home_col))
 
  ## annual losses per camper (campers x policies) for coefficient vector b
  person_loss <- function(b) {
    V  <- matrix(X1 %*% b[colnames(X1)], ncol = K, byrow = TRUE)
    P  <- exp(V - apply(V, 1, max)); P <- P / rowSums(P)
    bp <- -b[["price"]]
    L  <- 52 * log(1 - P[, site_cols, drop = FALSE]) / bp        # close one site
    colnames(L) <- sites
    cbind(L, "All sites closed" = 52 * log(P[, home_col]) / bp)  # only Stay_Home left
  }
  ## means per camper
  welf_summary <- function(b) {
    L <- person_loss(b); site <- L[, sites, drop = FALSE]
    c(colMeans(site),
      "Sum of single-site losses" = mean(rowSums(site)),
      "All sites closed"          = mean(L[, "All sites closed"]),
      "Average site closure"      = mean(colMeans(site)))
  }
 
  # ---  Krinsky-Robb ----------------------------------------------
  set.seed(898989 + yr)                                      
  draws <- MASS::mvrnorm(N_KR, coef(rum_mle_52), vcov(rum_mle_52))  
  kr <- t(apply(draws, 1, welf_summary))
  pt <- welf_summary(coef(rum_mle_52))
  kr_summary <- data.frame(measure = names(pt), mean = pt,
                           lower = apply(kr, 2, quantile, 0.025),
                           upper = apply(kr, 2, quantile, 0.975),
                           row.names = NULL)
  kr_list_52[[paste("52wk", yr)]] <<- list(summary = kr_summary, draws = kr)
  print(kr_summary, digits = 4, row.names = FALSE)
 
  # --- per-person point estimates (same output as before) -----------------
  Lp <- person_loss(coef(rum_mle_52))
  rum_person_results <- data.frame(
    id              = rep(pid, ncol(Lp)),
    annual_rum_loss = as.vector(Lp),
    parkname        = rep(colnames(Lp), each = nrow(Lp))
  )
 
  year_comparison <- rum_person_results %>%
    left_join(unique_users, by = "id") %>%
    mutate(year = yr)
 
  return(year_comparison)
})
 

saveRDS(model_list_52, "data/model_list_52.rds")
saveRDS(kr_list_52,    "data/kr_list_52.rds")
 

```




# Full Closure

```{r}
#| eval: false    
#| echo: true 
#| cache: true

# 1. Extract the Price Coefficient
beta_price <- coef(rum_mle)["price"]
model_list_52 <- readRDS("data/model_list_52.rds")
# 2. Calculate Total System Welfare Loss
# We compare the current state (All Parks) to the "Closed" state (Stay_Home Only)
total_system_welfare <- df_math %>%
  group_by(trip_id) %>%
  summarise(
    # Inclusive value (Log-Sum) of the current world:
    ls_base = log(sum(exp(V))),
    
    # Inclusive value if ONLY 'Stay_Home' exists (Everything else removed):
    ls_policy = log(sum(exp(V[park_name == "Stay_Home"]))),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # Welfare formula: (LS_policy - LS_base) / -beta_price
  mutate(cv_week = (ls_policy - ls_base) / -beta_price) %>%
  
  # Group by User ID to get the Annual Total
  mutate(id = as.character(str_remove(trip_id, "_w\\d+$"))) %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  summarise(annual_system_loss = sum(cv_week, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# 3. View the Results
summary_stats <- total_system_welfare %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Annual_Value = mean(annual_system_loss),
    Median_Annual_Value = median(annual_system_loss),
    Total_Sample_Value = sum(annual_system_loss)
  )

print(summary_stats)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true


model_list_52 <- readRDS("data/model_list_52.rds")
yrs <- c("2018", "2023")
comparison_list <- lapply(yrs, function(y) model_list_52[[paste("52wk", y)]])
names(comparison_list) <- yrs

## coefficient names in the order stargazer lists them (first model, then any new ones)
all_names <- unique(unlist(lapply(comparison_list, function(m) names(coef(m)))))

## rows to show: price, Keanakolu, then the other site constants alphabetically
key_rows  <- c("price", grep("Keanakolu", all_names, value = TRUE))
ord_names <- c(key_rows, sort(setdiff(all_names, key_rows)))
labels    <- sub("^\\(Intercept\\):", "", ord_names)
labels[ord_names == "price"] <- "Travel cost (price)"
labels    <- gsub("&", "and", labels)                     # "&" breaks HTML output

## campers and McFadden R2 for the bottom rows
n_campers <- sapply(comparison_list, function(m) {
  oid <- tryCatch(idx(m, 1), error = function(e) idx(m$model, 1))
  length(unique(oid)) / 52
})
mcf <- sapply(comparison_list, function(m) summary(m)$mfR2)

stargazer(
  comparison_list,
  type = "html",
  out = "tables/rum_comparison_results.html",
  title = "Table: Repeated RUM estimates, 2018 and 2023",
  column.labels = yrs,
  model.names = FALSE,
  model.numbers = FALSE,
  dep.var.labels.include = FALSE,
  single.row = TRUE,
  order = match(ord_names, all_names),
  covariate.labels = labels,
  add.lines = list(c("Individuals", n_campers),
                   c("McFadden R<sup>2</sup>", sprintf("%.3f", mcf))),
  omit.stat = c("f", "ser", "lr", "rsq", "adj.rsq"),
  star.cutoffs = c(0.05, 0.01, 0.001),
  no.space = TRUE,
  notes = c("Standard errors in parentheses. 52 weekly choice occasions per camper;","site constants are relative to staying home (reference alternative).")
)
```

#### Merge

```{r}
#| eval: false    
#| echo: true 


years <- 2018:2023
 
# ---- Baseline MDCEV: welfare_YYYY_ind from mdcev_pipeline_with_year_lists.R
# does NOT have parkname joined yet (that script left the original
# extraction loop untouched) -- join it here from each year's own model,
# same pattern as the satiation-off extraction already uses. ----
mdcev_baseline_all <- map_df(years, function(yr) {
  yr_chr <- as.character(yr)
  alt_names_yr <- mdcev_model_list[[yr_chr]]$parms_info$alt_names
  nalts <- length(alt_names_yr)
  site_lookup <- data.frame(
    site     = seq_len(nalts + 1),
    parkname = c(alt_names_yr, "Close_All")
  )
 
  get(paste0("welfare_", yr, "_ind")) %>%
    left_join(site_lookup, by = "site") %>%
    filter(!is.na(parkname)) %>%
    mutate(
      id       = as.character(id),
      year     = yr,
      parkname = ifelse(parkname == "Close_All", "Stay_Home", parkname)
    ) %>%
    select(id, parkname, year, zip, loss_mdcev = mean_value)
})
 
# ---- Satiation-off (100x): welfare_YYYY_100x_ind from
# satiation_100x_from_year_lists.R already has parkname + Close_All joined,
# so just relabel and select -- no site_lookup rebuild needed. ----
mdcev_100x_all <- map_df(years, function(yr) {
  get(paste0("welfare_", yr, "_100x_ind")) %>%
    mutate(
      id       = as.character(id),
      year     = yr,
      parkname = ifelse(parkname == "Close_All", "Stay_Home", parkname)
    ) %>%
    select(id, parkname, year, loss_mdcev_100x = mean_value)
})
 
# ---- Merge both onto the 52-week RUM comparison ----
mdcev_baseline_all$parkname[which(mdcev_baseline_all$parkname=="Stay_Home")]="All sites closed"


final_comparison_master <- final_comparison_52_person %>%
  mutate(id = as.character(id)) %>%
  left_join(mdcev_baseline_all, by = c("id", "parkname", "year", "zip")) 
 
head(final_comparison_master)
 


 
# ---- Same spot-check as before, now across all three ----
final_comparison_master %>%
  filter(id == "1201", year == 2018) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(coalesce(loss_mdcev, 0))))
```
